section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Study 2 Discussion', details the replication of findings from Study 1 using a larger sample and more elaborated personality measures. It explores zero-order correlations, regressions, and trait profiles, focusing on the relationships between self-evaluation scales (Self-Liking, RSES, SDE, Self-Competence) and Big Five personality traits and their facets. The discussion also touches upon the associations between Self-Competence and objective measures of ability and achievement, including IQ and creative achievement scores, noting their effect sizes.
